verdict.rationale: Kimi documents web search in its CLI and IDE integrations, and its help center lists search and a Deep Research (深度研究) feature. One community test shows it pulling from Wikipedia to ground an answer. However, nothing in the evidence documents citations or links back to sources in answers, and the help-center entries are only topic headings. Missing for 10: documented source citations in answers, in-depth docs on consumer web-grounded answering and Deep Research, independent corroboration of citation quality.

support.subject: As a knowledge-worker, I can get answers grounded in current web results with citations back to the sources
